product_one_liner.value: Matillion is a data integration platform that helps data teams build and manage data pipelines for AI and analytics at scale.

pricing_page.notes: Public page describes three plans and consumption-based credit pricing.

employee_band.notes: Company-size range listed on its LinkedIn company profile.

hq_location.notes: Matillion has dual headquarters in Manchester, United Kingdom, and Denver, United States.

eng_blog.notes: Two engineering-intern posts explain building a static pipeline-analysis tool and an AI-based internal monitoring tool.

public_docs.notes: Public product documentation includes an AI FAQ, pipeline-notes documentation, and a Maia Team overview.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Senior Staff AI Engineer posting includes an application link.

model_provider.value: AWS Bedrock, OpenAI's ChatGPT, and OpenAI for Azure
model_provider.notes: Matillion's AI FAQ explicitly names these third-party AI services.

compliance_certs.notes: Lists SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001:2022, GDPR compliance, and PCI DSS 4.0.1. GDPR is a compliance claim rather than a certification.

last_funding.notes: Databricks Ventures investment announced November 8, 2022; amount undisclosed. Tracxn classifies it as Series E, while the company announcement describes strategic venture funding without a series label.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest recorded funding was November 8, 2022, before the requested May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026 window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Sales Development Representative posting includes an application link.

launched_6mo.notes: Announced general availability of Maia Foundation on Google BigQuery on July 8, 2026, within the requested six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: On August 4, 2026, Matillion announced Girish Pancha as CEO and Sanjay Krishnamurthi as Chief Development Officer.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Named in SDR and SDR-manager job descriptions.
